note: Detectability ceiling for trace-only monitoring, pooled over the two corpora with a compromised class (DeepSeek + GPT-4o-mini, important_instructions). Labels use the CORRECTED polarity: security==True means the agent was compromised.

either_channel.meaning: TRUE ceiling for any trace-only detector

neither_channel.meaning: no trace evidence at all - undetectable in principle

key_observation: The published 0.9575 EXCEEDS this corpus's trace-only ceiling of 0.922, so it cannot be an apples-to-apples comparison: it must rest on a different positive-class definition, a different corpus, or information beyond the black-box trace.
